title: PAH-OMC-028 full minimal-domain nonlinear closure repair
question: Does the R-512 minimal closed form preserve every scalar normal contraction on its entire form domain, and does its existing spectral semigroup preserve one, after auditing the nonlinear Cauchy shortcut in R-530?
method: Freeze the PAH-001 and R-511/R-512/R-530 source hashes before the algebraic diagnostic; no model or rate changes.
Compute the paired-energy and form-distance estimates exactly using a directed-half sum and an independent generator matrix.
Prove closedness of the R-512 energy epigraph, including domain membership, then pass core contractions along arbitrary form recovery sequences.
Independently prove the same conclusion by weak compactness and Mazur convex approximants with growing supports.
Derive resolvent order preservation, spectral semigroup positivity and constant-one conservation using the same closed form.
Run non-importing independent and hostile controls, compile five Lean theorems, and build/render-review one three-page synthesis PDF.
finding: R-530's single-vector bound does not justify its immediate form-Cauchy inference; its purported paired estimate is false (difference energies 0 and 1, squared form norms 1 and 3/2). This is not a refutation of its conclusion or an example of a non-Cauchy image sequence. Closed-epigraph and weak-compactness proofs repair the same conditional conclusion on the full R-512 minimal domain. All normal contractions preserve the domain and decrease energy; the same target semigroup is positive, L-infinity contractive and preserves one.
decision_reason: A proof gap in an already selected target can be repaired without unavailable owner data or another scan. This improves the reliability of the proof spine; it does not supply the missing finite-to-target comparison.
boundary: The exact PAH function, rates, root conventions, probability state, regulator and j-before-anchored-n order are unchanged. R-510/R-511/R-512 analytic hypotheses are inherited. The two-value diagnostic tests a universal inequality only, not a new PAH carrier.
next_action: Separately freeze the Markov-extension domain contract for the same R-511 operator and H, then ask uniqueness versus a surviving boundary extension. Do not infer finite-to-target convergence from this question, and do not repeat unchanged owner scans.
